settings.title: Elysia settings
settings.intro: Limits and image processing applied to every upload. A value of 0 disables that check. Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
settings.disabled_reason: Select a default target format to enable this.

errors.max_file_size_required: Required: uploads need a byte ceiling.
errors.max_dimension_required: Required when a target format is set, or when thumbnails are enabled.

max_file_size.label: Maximum file size (bytes)
max_file_size.help: Reject uploads larger than this. 0 means no limit.

max_width.label: Maximum width (pixels)
max_width.help: Reject images wider than this. 0 means no limit. Required when a target format is set (it bounds server-side decoding).

max_height.label: Maximum height (pixels)
max_height.help: Reject images taller than this. 0 means no limit. Required when a target format is set (it bounds server-side decoding).

target_format.label: Default convert uploads to
target_format.help: Re-encode every upload to this format by default. 'Store as-is' turns off all processing (resize, conversion and target size below).

allow_overriding_file_format.label: Allow overriding the file format
allow_overriding_file_format.help: Let an upload pick its own output format. When off, the default above is always used. Enabling this requires the maximum width and height above (overrides can trigger server-side decoding).

target_width.label: Resize to fit width (pixels)
target_width.help: Shrink images to fit within this width, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means no resize; images are never upscaled.

target_height.label: Resize to fit height (pixels)
target_height.help: Shrink images to fit within this height, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means no resize; images are never upscaled.

target_file_size.label: Target file size (bytes)
target_file_size.help: If a processed image is still larger than this, lossy-compress it down to fit. 0 means off.

default_compression.label: Default compression quality (1-100)
default_compression.help: Lossy quality applied when an upload does not request one. 0 means lossless by default.

allow_overriding_compression.label: Allow overriding compression
allow_overriding_compression.help: Let an upload request its own compression quality. When off, the default above is always used.
allow_overriding_compression.forced_help: Required: AVIF and JPEG have no lossless mode, so with no default compression an upload must set its own quality.

strip_exif_by_default.label: Strip EXIF by default
strip_exif_by_default.help: Remove metadata such as camera model, GPS location and timestamps from uploads that do not request otherwise.

allow_overriding_strip_exif.label: Allow overriding metadata stripping
allow_overriding_strip_exif.help: Let an upload choose whether to strip its own metadata. When off, the default above is always used.

settings.thumbnails_intro: A smaller preview served from /t/ instead of /i/. Enabled when a width or height is set. Not overridable per upload; images already within the box are served unchanged.

thumbnail_width.label: Thumbnail width (pixels)
thumbnail_width.help: Shrink the thumbnail to fit within this width, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means unconstrained on this axis.

thumbnail_height.label: Thumbnail height (pixels)
thumbnail_height.help: Shrink the thumbnail to fit within this height, keeping aspect ratio. 0 means unconstrained on this axis.

thumbnail_quality.label: Thumbnail quality (1-100)
thumbnail_quality.help: Lossy WebP quality for generated thumbnails.

uploads_enabled.label: Enable uploads
uploads_enabled.help: When off, nobody can upload or rehost images, admins included. Existing images stay online.

settings.accounts_intro: Who may create an account on this instance.

allow_registration.label: Allow open registration
allow_registration.help: When on, anyone may create a local account. When off, only a future single sign-on provider can provision users.

default_storage_quota.label: Default storage quota per user
default_storage_quota.help: Total size of the available and trashed images each user may keep. 0 means no limit. Admins are exempt, and admins can override it per user from their profile.

allowed_referrers.label: Allowed referrers
allowed_referrers.help: Hostnames allowed to embed images (/i/ and /t/), checked against the Referer header. Press Enter after each one. Empty allows any site and direct links. Elysia's own host is always allowed.

record_referrer_views.label: Record views per referrer
record_referrer_views.help: When on, views are split by the site they came from. When off, every view is counted as "no referrer". WARNING: without allowed referrers, any site (or a forged Referer header) adds new rows, so storage can grow without bound.

api_keys.scope_full_help: Everything, except changing your password, managing API keys and admin actions.
api_keys.revoke_confirm: Revoke {name}? Anything using it stops working right away.
api_keys.token_once: Copy this token now: it will not be shown again.

fixtures.title: Generate fixtures
fixtures.help: Uploads generated images through the real pipeline, from fixture users, dated over the past days. Existing fixture users keep their password.

unreferenced_images.title: Unreferenced images
unreferenced_images.help: Scans the text columns of a Postgres or MySQL database in the background for links to this instance's images, thumbnails or viewer pages under the given hosts (add every domain, alias or CDN the links may use), one query per table, and lists the available images linked from nowhere. Links are found ignoring case, JSON-escaped or URL-encoded, but not as relative paths or bare ids. Nothing is changed until you delete them, which moves them to the trash. Deleting them all is refused once the scan is more than 24 hours old.
unreferenced_images.hosts: Hosts the links use, e.g. img.example.com, old.example.com
unreferenced_images.exclude: Exclude these tables or columns, e.g. logs, posts.raw (optional)
unreferenced_images.summary: Last scan: {columns} columns read, {referenced} linked images found
unreferenced_images.empty: No unreferenced images from the last scan

similar_images.title: Similar images
similar_images.help: Finds available images that look alike, such as recompressed, resized or converted copies, by comparing their perceptual hashes (64 bits, computed on upload). Images differing in at most the maximum distance are grouped, also through each other. Nothing is changed until you delete some, which moves them to the trash.
similar_images.max_distance: Maximum distance (0 to 16 bits; 0 only matches identical looking images, about 10 also matches edited copies)
similar_images.empty: No similar images from the last scan

chevereto_import.title: Chevereto import
chevereto_import.help: Copies every image of a Chevereto v4 instance into Elysia in the background. Images are read from Chevereto's MySQL database and downloaded over HTTP, then go through the normal upload pipeline (thumbnails, EXIF stripping, dedup) with the size and pixel limits lifted. Each image keeps its upload date and, when uploaders are matched, its uploader. Chevereto must use its default paths (upload_image_path 'images', route_image 'image') or the import refuses to run. Database urls are not stored: fill them in again to resume.

chevereto_database_url.label: Chevereto database url
chevereto_database_url.help: MySQL or MariaDB connection to the Chevereto database, with the default chv_ table prefix, e.g. mysql://chevereto:password@localhost:3306/chevereto.

chevereto_public_url.label: Chevereto public url
chevereto_public_url.help: Base url of the Chevereto site. Images are downloaded from it (or from their external storage), so Elysia's server must reach it.

link_hosts.label: Chevereto link hosts
link_hosts.help: Comma separated hosts, with the port when not the default one, whose Chevereto links are rewritten in the backend database. Add every alias the links may use. Empty uses the host of the public url.

backend_database_url.label: Backend database url
backend_database_url.help: Postgres connection to the application storing Chevereto links (e.g. arcadia). After each chunk, the Chevereto image, medium, thumbnail and viewer links in every text-like column of every table are rewritten to Elysia links built from server.public_url in config.yml, in one transaction, and only changed rows are updated. A column too short for the new link stops the import without committing that chunk: widen it and resume. Each chunk scans every text column, so time a run against a copy of a production-size database first. Empty imports the images without rewriting any link.

match_users.label: Match uploaders to backend users
match_users.help: Chevereto uploaders whose username exists in the backend's users table become that backend's SSO users in Elysia (auth.sso must be configured in config.yml). Off, every image goes to the fallback user.

users_table.label: Users table
users_table.help: Table holding the backend's users, optionally schema qualified, e.g. public.users.

username_column.label: Username column
username_column.help: Column matched exactly against the Chevereto username.

subject_column.label: SSO subject column
subject_column.help: Column holding the user's SSO subject, the OIDC sub claim the backend sends Elysia at sign-in.

email_column.label: Email column
email_column.help: Column copied as the Elysia account's email. Optional, leave empty to skip it.

fallback_username.label: Fallback user
fallback_username.help: Elysia user, created if missing, owning guest uploads and images of Chevereto users without a backend account (or every image when uploaders are not matched).

batch_size.label: Batch size
batch_size.help: Images read from Chevereto per chunk. Progress is saved and links are rewritten once per chunk, so a stopped run replays at most one chunk. Bigger chunks mean fewer scans of the backend database.

concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.help: Images downloaded and processed in parallel.

chevereto_import.buttons_help: Resume continues after the last saved chunk. Retry failed restarts from the lowest failed image and replays everything after it. Restart from scratch starts over from the first image and forgets the failures. Replayed images are deduplicated, so no copy is stored twice. Stop ends the run once its current chunk is saved.
chevereto_import.restart_confirm: Start over from the first Chevereto image? Already imported images are deduplicated, but every image is downloaded again.
chevereto_import.progress: {done} / {total} images processed, {imported} imported, {failed} failed in total, {rewritten_rows} backend rows rewritten, last saved image id {last_image_id}
chevereto_import.interrupted: The last run was interrupted by a server restart. Resume to continue.
